# Quarto Integration Patterns

## GitHub Integration

### GitHub Actions for Automatic Publishing

``` yaml
# .github/workflows/publish.yml
name: Publish Quarto Website

on:
  push:
    branches: main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4

      - name: Setup Quarto
        uses: quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install Python Dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Setup R
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          use-public-rspm: true

      - name: Install R Dependencies
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          packages: |
            any::knitr
            any::rmarkdown
            any::ggplot2
            any::dplyr

      - name: Render and Publish
        uses: quarto-dev/quarto-actions/publish@v2
        with:
          target: gh-pages
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v3
```

### Automated Rendering on Push

``` yaml
# .github/workflows/render.yml
name: Render Documents

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '**.qmd'
      - '**.yml'
      - '**.yaml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.qmd'
      - '**.yml'
      - '**.yaml'

jobs:
  render:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Quarto
        uses: quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install jupyter matplotlib pandas plotly seaborn

      - name: Render changed documents
        run: |
          # Get list of changed QMD files
          changed_files=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.before }} ${{ github.sha }} | grep '\.qmd$' || true)

          if [ -n "$changed_files" ]; then
            echo "Rendering changed files:"
            echo "$changed_files"

            for file in $changed_files; do
              if [ -f "$file" ]; then
                echo "Rendering $file"
                quarto render "$file"
              fi
            done
          else
            echo "No QMD files changed"
          fi

      - name: Commit rendered files
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add -A
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Auto-render documents [skip ci]"
          git push
```

## Docker Integration

### Dockerfile for Quarto Environment

``` dockerfile
# Dockerfile
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts from apt
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install system dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    curl \
    wget \
    gdebi-core \
    pandoc \
    pandoc-citeproc \
    python3 \
    python3-pip \
    python3-venv \
    r-base \
    r-base-dev \
    git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Quarto
ARG QUARTO_VERSION="1.4.550"
RUN curl -LO https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/releases/download/v${QUARTO_VERSION}/quarto-${QUARTO_VERSION}-linux-amd64.deb \
    && gdebi --non-interactive quarto-${QUARTO_VERSION}-linux-amd64.deb \
    && rm quarto-${QUARTO_VERSION}-linux-amd64.deb

# Install Python packages
RUN pip3 install \
    jupyter \
    matplotlib \
    pandas \
    plotly \
    seaborn \
    numpy \
    scipy \
    scikit-learn

# Install R packages
RUN R -e "install.packages(c('ggplot2', 'dplyr', 'knitr', 'rmarkdown', 'plotly', 'DT'), repos='https://cran.rstudio.com/')"

# Create working directory
WORKDIR /workspace

# Copy project files
COPY . .

# Install project-specific dependencies
RUN if [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then pip3 install -r requirements.txt; fi
RUN if [ -f "renv.lock" ]; then R -e "install.packages('renv'); renv::restore()"; fi

# Expose port for preview
EXPOSE 4200

# Default command
CMD ["quarto", "preview", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "4200"]
```

### Docker Compose

``` yaml
# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'

services:
  quarto:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "4200:4200"
    volumes:
      - .:/workspace
      - quarto_cache:/workspace/.quarto
    environment:
      - QUARTO_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3
      - QUARTO_R=/usr/bin/R
    command: quarto preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200

  render:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    volumes:
      - .:/workspace
      - quarto_cache:/workspace/.quarto
    command: quarto render
    profiles:
      - render

volumes:
  quarto_cache:
```

## Database Integration

### Connecting to Databases

``` python
# database-integration.qmd (Python chunks)

import pandas as pd
import sqlite3
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

# SQLite connection
def load_data_from_sqlite(db_path, query):
    """Load data from SQLite database."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
    conn.close()
    return df

# PostgreSQL connection
def load_data_from_postgres(connection_string, query):
    """Load data from PostgreSQL database."""
    engine = create_engine(connection_string)
    df = pd.read_sql_query(query, engine)
    engine.dispose()
    return df

# Example usage in Quarto document
```

# Connect to database
engine = create_engine(params['database_url'])

# Query data
query = f"""
SELECT
    DATE(order_date) as date,
    SUM(amount) as daily_sales
FROM orders
WHERE order_date BETWEEN '{params['start_date']}' AND '{params['end_date']}'
GROUP BY DATE(order_date)

"""

df = pd.read_sql_query(query, engine)
engine.dispose()

# Display summary
print(f"Total sales: ${df['daily_sales'].sum():,.2f}")

## Cloud Platform Integration

### AWS S3 Data Loading

``` python
# aws-integration.py
import boto3
import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO

def load_data_from_s3(bucket, key, aws_access_key_id=None, aws_secret_access_key=None):
    """Load CSV data from S3 bucket."""
    s3_client = boto3.client(
        's3',
        aws_access_key_id=aws_access_key_id,
        aws_secret_access_key=aws_secret_access_key
    )

    response = s3_client.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
    csv_string = response['Body'].read().decode('utf-8')
    df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(csv_string))
    return df

# Usage in Quarto document
# df = load_data_from_s3('my-bucket', 'data/sales.csv')
```

### Google Sheets Integration

``` python
# google-sheets-integration.py
import pandas as pd
from google.oauth2.service_account import Credentials
import gspread

def load_data_from_google_sheets(sheet_url, worksheet_name=None, credentials_file=None):
    """Load data from Google Sheets."""
    if credentials_file:
        gc = gspread.service_account(filename=credentials_file)
    else:
        gc = gspread.service_account()

    sheet = gc.open_by_url(sheet_url)

    if worksheet_name:
        worksheet = sheet.worksheet(worksheet_name)
    else:
        worksheet = sheet.sheet1

    data = worksheet.get_all_records()
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)
    return df

# Usage
# df = load_data_from_google_sheets(
#     'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/your-sheet-id',
#     'Sheet1',
#     'service-account-key.json'
# )
```

## API Integration

### REST API Data Fetching

``` python
# api-integration.py
import requests
import pandas as pd
import json

def fetch_api_data(url, headers=None, params=None):
    """Fetch data from REST API."""
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

def fetch_paginated_data(base_url, headers=None, page_param='page', per_page=100):
    """Fetch all data from paginated API."""
    all_data = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        params = {page_param: page, 'per_page': per_page}
        data = fetch_api_data(base_url, headers=headers, params=params)

        if not data or len(data) == 0:
            break

        all_data.extend(data)
        page += 1

        # Break if we got less than expected (last page)
        if len(data) < per_page:
            break

    return all_data

# Example usage in Quarto document
```

## Jupyter Integration

### Converting Notebooks to Quarto

``` python
# notebook-converter.py
import json
import yaml
from pathlib import Path

def convert_notebook_to_quarto(notebook_path, output_path=None):
    """Convert Jupyter notebook to Quarto document."""
    if output_path is None:
        output_path = Path(notebook_path).with_suffix('.qmd')

    with open(notebook_path, 'r') as f:
        notebook = json.load(f)

    # Extract metadata
    metadata = notebook.get('metadata', {})

    # Create YAML front matter
    front_matter = {
        'title': metadata.get('title', 'Converted Notebook'),
        'format': 'html',
        'jupyter': metadata.get('kernelspec', {}).get('name', 'python3')
    }

    # Start building content
    content = ['---']
    content.append(yaml.dump(front_matter, default_flow_style=False).strip())
    content.append('---\n')

    # Process cells
    for cell in notebook['cells']:
        if cell['cell_type'] == 'markdown':
            content.extend(cell['source'])
            content.append('\n')
        elif cell['cell_type'] == 'code':
            # Add code block with language specification
            content.append(f"```{{{metadata.get('kernelspec', {}).get('name', 'python')}}}")
            content.extend(cell['source'])
            content.append('```\n')

    # Write to file
    with open(output_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(content))

    print(f"Converted {notebook_path} to {output_path}")

# Usage
convert_notebook_to_quarto('analysis.ipynb', 'analysis.qmd')
```

### Jupyter Kernel Management

``` python
# kernel-management.py
import subprocess
import json

def list_jupyter_kernels():
    """List available Jupyter kernels."""
    result = subprocess.run(['jupyter', 'kernelspec', 'list', '--json'],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
    kernels = json.loads(result.stdout)
    return kernels['kernelspecs']

def install_kernel(kernel_name, display_name, python_path):
    """Install a new Jupyter kernel."""
    kernel_json = {
        "argv": [python_path, "-m", "ipykernel_launcher", "-f", "{connection_file}"],
        "display_name": display_name,
        "language": "python",
        "metadata": {"debugger": True}
    }

    # Create kernel specification
    import tempfile
    import os

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
        kernel_dir = os.path.join(temp_dir, kernel_name)
        os.makedirs(kernel_dir)

        with open(os.path.join(kernel_dir, 'kernel.json'), 'w') as f:
            json.dump(kernel_json, f, indent=2)

        # Install kernel
        subprocess.run(['jupyter', 'kernelspec', 'install', kernel_dir,
                       '--name', kernel_name, '--user'])

    print(f"Installed kernel: {kernel_name}")

# Check available kernels
kernels = list_jupyter_kernels()
for name, spec in kernels.items():
    print(f"Kernel: {name} - {spec['spec']['display_name']}")
```

## Continuous Integration Patterns

### Multi-Environment Testing

``` yaml
# .github/workflows/test-environments.yml
name: Test Multiple Environments

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10', '3.11']
        r-version: ['4.2', '4.3']

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Quarto
        uses: quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Setup R
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: ${{ matrix.r-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          Rscript -e "install.packages(c('ggplot2', 'dplyr'))"

      - name: Test rendering
        run: |
          quarto check
          quarto render test-document.qmd

      - name: Upload artifacts
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: failed-render-${{ matrix.os }}-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-r${{ matrix.r-version }}
          path: |
            *.html
            *.log
```

### Deployment Pipeline

``` yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy.yml
name: Deploy to Production

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: quarto-dev/quarto-actions/setup@v2

      - name: Build site
        run: quarto render

      - name: Deploy to staging
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          # Deploy to staging environment
          echo "Deploying to staging"

      - name: Deploy to production
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          # Deploy to production environment
          echo "Deploying to production"
```
